# `kll_merge_agg_double`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
kll_merge_agg_double(expr[, k])
```

Merges binary KllDoublesSketch representations and returns the merged sketch.
The input expression should contain binary sketch representations (e.g., from kll_sketch_agg_double).
The optional k parameter controls the size and accuracy of the merged sketch (range 8-65535).
If k is not specified, the merged sketch adopts the k value from the first input sketch.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not in the function registry yet |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.2 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT kll_sketch_get_n_double(kll_merge_agg_double(sketch)) FROM (SELECT kll_sketch_agg_double(col) as sketch FROM VALUES (CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE)), (CAST(2.0 AS DOUBLE)), (CAST(3.0 AS DOUBLE)) tab(col) UNION ALL SELECT kll_sketch_agg_double(col) as sketch FROM VALUES (CAST(4.0 AS DOUBLE)), (CAST(5.0 AS DOUBLE)), (CAST(6.0 AS DOUBLE)) tab(col)) t;
```

Result:

```text
6
```
